system.creatureSubtype: immune to poison, disease, fear; Fortune on saves vs magic; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 60 ft, Truesight 30 ft, Keen Hearing and Smell
system.tactics: Hound Archons are guardians first. They position to protect the summoner and designated allies, using Magic Circle to establish a safe zone when under pressure. They engage threats directly prioritizing undead and fiends. They can disguise themselves to blend into a crowd if needed for a protection mission.
system.attacksNotes:
Holy Sword [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str) + 3 Positive damage (Half DR)
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Positive damage; undead and fiends gain Frightened condition
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Positive damage; condition applies with no save

Bite [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 10 damage (6 + 4 Str)
  • Margin 2: 10 damage, DR halved (round up)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Change Shape: The Hound Archon can assume the form of any Medium humanoid as a [Interact] action. Its stats do not change; the form is cosmetic only. Magic Circle: Once per encounter, the Hound Archon can establish a 10-foot diameter zone of protection centered on a point within 30 feet. Fiends and corrupted creatures cannot enter this zone and cannot charm, frighten, or possess creatures within it. Duration 10 minutes.
